UN Volunteer Specialist assignments for Korean nationals
UN Volunteer Specialist assignments for Korean nationals are financed by the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs, Korea and implemented by the United Nations Volunteers (UNV). This initiative offers qualified
professionals the opportunity to serve as UN Volunteers for a period of 12 to 24 months, contributing
to development efforts across diverse country contexts in support of the mandates and work of United
Nations entities. Through their assignments, UN Volunteers share their expertise and skills, expand
their peer networks, and gain international experience within the United Nations system.
UNV provides global citizens with an opportunity to volunteer across the three pillars of the United
Nations: development; peace and security; and human rights. In 2025, over 17,000 UN Volunteers
served with 59 UN partners in 172 countries and territories worldwide.

Prerequisites
Only Korean nationals who have not yet served as a UN Volunteer Specialist funded by the
Government of Korea are eligible to apply. Former UN Youth Volunteers , UN Volunteer Associates,
and UN University Volunteers are eligible to apply.
Minimum requirements: 27 years of age at the time of application, university degree as stipulated in
the respective Description of Assignment, and three years of relevant professional experience.
In line with UNV’s Recruitment and Selection Policy for UN Volunteers, serving UN Volunteers will not
be considered for other UN Volunteer assignments until they reach three months before the end of
contract date of their current UN Volunteer assignment. This provision applies equally to first and
subsequent contracts.
Selection process
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The selection will be done by the UN host entity in the
country of assignment. Competency-based i nterviews will be conducted by the UN host entity in
November 2026.
How to apply
Candidates may apply to a maximum of three assignments and indicate the order of preference in the
‘Additional remarks’ field when filling in the application form.
